import requests
from pathlib import Path

url = ''https://cdn-wp.datapress.cloud/london/20250618131339/Indicator-matrix-data-sheets-Nov-2020.xlsx''
dest = Path\(''data/raw/economic_fairness/indicator_matrix_nov_2020.xlsx''\)
dest.parent.mkdir\(parents=True, exist_ok=True\)

print\(f''Downloading from: {url}''\)
response = requests.get\(url, stream=True\)
response.raise_for_status\(\)

with open\(dest, ''wb''\) as f:
    for chunk in response.iter_content\(chunk_size=8192\):
        f.write\(chunk\)

print\(f''Saved to: {dest}''\)
print\(f''File size: {dest.stat\(\).st_size / 1024:.1f} KB''\)
")
